remarks: Updated & Spacious West-facing studio in the pulse of vibrant downtown offers beautiful sunsets and overlooks popular Latham Park + green! Heat + hot water are included in rent. Located in a secure, mid-rise building, you'll enjoy flexible space featuring high 9' ceilings, polished hardwood floorings, updated kitchen, newer bath + small private storage area. Enjoy the ease of urban living, walk to popular restaurants, shops, theater, UCONN, library, pubs & train station. Parking is available at nearby Forest St. garage for approximately $75/month. Interested parties please complete the Parkview application found in supplements, cost $50.00 per applicant. After tenant vacates, this apartment will be professionally cleaned + made to sparkle!
